reason: This is not just a local rename. The metadata shows a cross-layer change to KV read-timeout behavior plus removal of a statement hint, touching parser SQL semantics, planner hint handling, session/sysvar behavior, executor request building, and TiKV request plumbing. Files in `parser/*`, `planner/core/*`, `executor/*`, `sessionctx/*`, `distsql/*`, `kv/*`, and `store/*` make this high-blast-radius enough to justify a focused Blocker/High review for compatibility and correctness gaps such as hint removal fallout, old/new variable aliasing, precedence changes, and timeout propagation being dropped on some paths.
